summary: Auth System Remediation: Fix ctx.auth.getUserIdentity() returning NULL by adding GDPR authorization guards (P0) and integrating WorkOS JWT with Convex Auth (P1). Target security score improvement from 4/10 to 8/10.

phases.name: IMMEDIATE Security Fixes (P0)
phases.description: Add authorization guards to unprotected GDPR endpoints and convert admin queries to internal. This phase MUST deploy with Phase 1.1-1.2 to avoid breaking guards.

subtasks.description: Add authorization guards to 9 GDPR functions in convex/gdpr.ts: createConsent (requireEmployerOwnership), withdrawConsent (requireEmployerOwnership), requestErasure (keep public for patient self-request), processErasure (requireAdmin), listErasureRequests (requireAdmin), getConsentsByPatient (requireEmployerOwnership), getAuditLogs (requireAdmin), getAuditLogsByResource (requireAdmin), getGDPRStats (requireAdmin). Import guards from convex/authModules.
acceptanceCriteria: All 8 GDPR mutations/queries have authorization guards
Guards use existing helpers from convex/authModules/authorization.ts
requestErasure remains public for patient self-request

subtasks.description: Convert admin queries to internal in convex/adminUsers.ts: Change getByWorkosUserId from query to internalQuery, change getByEmail from query to internalQuery. Note: AdminLayout.tsx uses getByWorkosUserId - requires workaround in Phase 1.
acceptanceCriteria: Document frontend impact for Phase 1 workaround

phases.gateCondition: Typecheck passes. CRITICAL: Do NOT deploy until Phase 1.1-1.2 complete - guards depend on ctx.auth integration.

phases.name: Convex Auth Integration (P1)
phases.description: Configure Convex to accept WorkOS JWT tokens so ctx.auth.getUserIdentity() returns user identity instead of null.

subtasks.description: Create convex/auth.config.ts to configure WorkOS as JWT provider. Configure domain as https://api.workos.com and applicationID from WORKOS_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

Update src/main.tsx (21 lines) to use ConvexProviderWithAuth instead of ConvexProvider. Create ConvexAuthBridge component that uses useWorkOSAuth() to provide tokens to Convex. Tokens from localStorage must be passed via fetchAccessToken callback.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth bridge extracts tokens from appropriate role context
No runtime errors on page load

subtasks.description: Add POST /auth/refresh endpoint to convex/http.ts (225 lines). Use WorkOS SDK authenticateWithRefreshToken method to refresh tokens. Return new accessToken and refreshToken in JSON response.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses WorkOS SDK for token refresh
Returns JSON with accessToken and refreshToken
Error handling for invalid refresh tokens

subtasks.description: Add refreshAccessToken function to src/lib/workos-auth.tsx (412 lines). Implement mutex to prevent concurrent refresh attempts. Call /auth/refresh endpoint and update localStorage. Add auto-refresh before token expiry.

Create workaround for AdminLayout.tsx dependency on getByWorkosUserId (now internal). Options: (A) Create public wrapper with auth check, (B) Use HTTP action endpoint, (C) Refactor AdminLayout to use different data flow.
acceptanceCriteria: No public exposure of admin enumeration

phases.gateCondition: All subtasks complete. Typecheck passes. ctx.auth.getUserIdentity() returns user identity in dev environment.

phases.name: Validation & Verification
phases.description: Verify auth integration works end-to-end. Test all role portals.

subtasks.description: Verify admin portal authentication: Login as admin, access /admin dashboard, verify ctx.auth.getUserIdentity() returns user in backend logs, verify GDPR queries work with authorization.
Verify employer portal authentication: Login as employer, access /employer/dashboard, verify employer queries work, test employee creation with consent.
Verify authorization guards: Attempt cross-role access (employer trying admin endpoints), verify ConvexError with UNAUTHORIZED code returned.
acceptanceCriteria: Errors logged with correct UNAUTHORIZED code

phases.gateCondition: All validation tests pass. Screenshots captured for evidence. No UNAUTHENTICATED errors in normal flows.

risks.description: WorkOS JWT format may not be compatible with Convex built-in providers
risks.mitigation: Implement custom JWT verification in HTTP action as fallback

risks.description: Phase 0 guards will break if deployed before Phase 1 (ctx.auth returns null)
risks.mitigation: Deploy Phase 0 + Phase 1.1-1.2 together in single deployment

risks.description: AdminLayout dependency on getByWorkosUserId may require refactoring

risks.mitigation: Mutex implementation in Task 1.4 prevents concurrent refresh
